title: The Dark Truth About Mephisto (novel) #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Mephisto (novel) shows exactly where that breaks. The novel adapts themes from the Faust legend to follow the life of actor Hendrik Höfgen, a thinly disguised portrait of German actor Gustaf Gründgens. The actor abandons his conscience to ingratiate himself with the National Socialist German Workers Party (Nazis), keep his job and improve his social positions.

The selfish-gene reading of Mephisto (novel) makes it less romantic and far more precise. Höfgen buys a huge villa in Grunewald and calls his sister and parents to Berlin. He now marries Nicoletta to put an end to the rumours of his relationship with a black woman.
